answer: The network enforces capacity-reservations, requiring 1,000 agents to secure independent service slots. A verifier probes for a signal latency of exactly 5ms; any deviation toward relayed traffic voids the reservation. This jade-hued constraint prevents pooling across rented machines. An honest participant pays 1x cost, whereas an attacker incurs 1,000x for isolated nodes. Reaching this zenith of precision mandates 90-day locks.
